name: 实现规范与单一路径

question.instructions: Evaluate Implementation Hygiene: single implementation path for core capabilities, no swallowed exceptions, standardized logging.

criteria.passed: Single implementation path for core domain logic; exceptions retain original cause without being swallowed; clean error handling.
criteria.violated: Dual-track parser or converter introduced, swallowed exceptions ignoring error context, or broken logging standards.

why: 核心正交架构红线：同一核心领域能力全工程保持唯一实现路径，禁止吞异常用空值掩盖故障第一现场。
